name: creative-zen-mode
description: Zen Mode, typewriter centering, focus fade and paragraph rhythm for creative writing in Obsidian.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm test && node -e "const m=require('./manifest.json'),p=require('./package.json');if(m.version!==p.version)throw new Error('manifest/package version mismatch')"
